defs.def: to put sth firmly in a place so that it will not move 使固定；安装

ex.s: Conventional air pollution monitors are normally fixed on lampposts at about nine feet in the air.
ex.t: 这位英国少年注意到，地面附近的污染水平比机构记录高度处的污染水平高出约三分之二。

ex.s: Whatever the mistake, remember it isn’t a fixed aspect of your personality.
ex.t: 无论犯了什么错，记住它不是你性格中固定不变的一面。

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究发现，大象要么在离煎饼固定距离处使用吸力把物体抬到空中并吸住，要么轻轻把象鼻尖压在煎饼上施加吸力把它捡起。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识这样的人，他们在到达人生的中点之前就失去了动力。我说的不是那些没能登上顶峰的人。我们不可能都到达顶峰。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们接受了那些常常伴随岁月流逝而来的固定态度和观念。

ex.s: Prefixes and suffixes often have fixed meanings.
ex.t: 前缀和后缀通常有固定的含义。

ex.s: Along this road, Stephen’s grandfather built a simple basket by fixing a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 沿着这条路，Stephen 的祖父用一块塑料板固定做了一个简易的篮筐。

ex.s: Instead of being fixed in place like most ordinary buildings, the new buildings they have designed can move.
ex.t: 与他们设计的新型建筑不像大多数普通建筑那样固定在一个地方，它们可以移动。

defs.def: to decide on a date, a time, an amount, etc. for sth 决定，确定（日期、时间、数量等）

ex.s: A fixed frame will make time meaningless．
ex.t: 固定的框架会让时间失去意义。

ex.s: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume — even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
ex.t: 相反，她建议采用营养专家中一个知名的理念，叫做“责任分工”：父母在固定时间给孩子提供各种大多健康的食物，而孩子自己决定想吃什么、吃多少——即便这意味着偶尔吃更多饼干而非胡萝卜。

defs.def: to arrange or organize sth 安排；组织
to discover or say the exact position, time, etc. of sth 找到，确定，说出（确切位置、时间等）
to repair or correct sth 修理；校准；校正

ex.s: has been fixedB. is being fixed
ex.t: 已经修好了B. 正在修理

ex.s: had been fixedD. would be fixed
ex.t: 已经被修好D. 将会被修理

ex.s: They promised to fix the window.
ex.t: 他们承诺修好窗户。

ex.s: Fix the instruments.
ex.t: 修理乐器。

ex.s: He 23   to fix bikes free of charge for anyone who needed it.
ex.t: 他   23   承诺免费为任何需要的人修理自行车。

ex.s: While he is trying to fix his aeroplane, a little prince comes to him.
ex.t: 当他试图修理他的飞机时，一个小王子来到他面前。

ex.s: Henry   62   （fix）his car when he heard the screams.
ex.t: Henry正在   62  （fix）修车时听到了尖叫声。

ex.s: 30    simply satisfying a material need, he has provided an opportunity for kids in his neighborhood to learn how to fix their own bikes.
ex.t: 30    不仅满足了物质需求他还为社区里的孩子们提供了一个学习修理自己自行车的机会。

ex.s: Get someone to fix the old one
ex.t: 找人来修旧的

ex.s: This way, you will be able to fix the problem before your home becomes flooded or catches fire.
ex.t: 这样，你就能在家被淹或起火之前解决问题。

ex.s: It won’t fix everything in our lives—but for some reason, it helps.
ex.t: 它不会解决我们生活中的一切——但由于某种原因，它确实有帮助。

ex.s: “It’s not going to fix everything, but adaptive signals have some benefits for smaller cities,” he says.
ex.t: "它不能解决所有问题，但对较小的城市来说，自适应信号有一些好处，"他说。

ex.s: Removing gender from the picture altogether seems like a simple way to fix this.
ex.t: 把性别完全从画面中剔除，似乎是解决这个问题的简单办法。

defs.def: to provide or prepare sth, especially food 提供，准备（尤指食物）

ex.s: Offering various foods to kids at fixed times.
ex.t: 在固定时间为孩子们提供各种食物。

defs.def: to make sth such as your hair or face neat and attractive 梳洗；整理；收拾
to arrange the result of sth in a way that is not honest or fair 操纵；作弊
to punish sb who has harmed you and stop them doing you any more harm 惩罚；收拾
to treat film for cameras, etc. with a chemical so that the colours do not change or become less bright 定（影）；定（色）
to make an animal unable to have young by means of an operation 阉割（家畜）
a solution to a problem, especially an easy or temporary one （尤指简单、暂时的）解决方法
an amount of sth that you need and want frequently, especially an illegal drug such as heroin （致瘾的东西，尤指毒品的）一次用量

ex.s: They teased the dog by fixing the treat to the screen.
ex.t: 一次难忘的体育赛事。

defs.def: a difficult situation 困境；窘境
the act of finding the position of a ship or an aircraft （船或飞机的）方位确定，定位
an act of understanding sth 理解；了解
a thing that is dishonestly arranged; a trick 受操纵的事；勾当；搞鬼
